output_list.reason: The mint function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The condition 'require(totalSupply + _value <= TOKEN_LIMIT);' is incorrect because if totalSupply overflows, it can be manipulated to allow for an unlimited number of tokens to be minted.
The burn function allows any user to burn any amount of tokens, which can be exploited to cause a denial of service to the token holders.

The transfer function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The function does not check if the subtraction of balances will result in underflow, allowing attackers to exploit this vulnerability to increase attackers' token balance.

The transferFrom function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The function does not check if the subtraction of balances will result in underflow, allowing attackers to exploit this vulnerability to increase attackers' token balance.

The approve function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The function does not check if the addition of allowed will result in overflow, allowing attackers to exploit this vulnerability to increase attackers' allowance.
